_doc: Colour looks (ffmpeg filters) applied after the automatic correction (exposure + white balance). job.json "grade": a look name below, "none", or a raw filter string. "house" = signature-style.json grade. Skin stays natural in every look: keep changes to shadows/highlights, never push mids far. Skin check: every look is rendered on a test face (engine/reel/engine/color.mjs --still); no look may turn skin orange.

natural.label: Natural
natural.use: true-to-life; tutorials, interviews, already well-lit footage

house.label: House
house.use: Zancut default for dark looks: teal shadows, cool highlights, gentle S-curve, natural skin

golden.label: Golden
golden.use: light, bright, warm; light look and lifestyle

cinematic.label: Cinematic
cinematic.use: story, drama, premium: teal shadows, deeper contrast, calm skin
